newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Cementos Lima to issue $60 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Cementos Lima to issue $60 mln in bonds.

text.p: Peru's largest cement company, Cementos Lima, plans to make a series of bond issues up to an equivalent of $60 million on the local market, the Lima stock exchange said Friday.
The debt will carry an annual interest rate of between eight percent and 10 percent, the stock exchange said in its daily report. The report did not say when the company would issue the bonds.
The proceeds of the bonds, which will have a four-year maturity, will be used exclusively for expansion of the company's production plant, the report said.
Peru's largest commercial bank Banco de Credito and local financial company Interinvest SA will handle the placement of the bonds.
